title: Bigcraft modpack
description: The dedicated modpack for the BigCraft server.
body:
# BigCraft Dedicated Modpack
**BigCraft Dedicated Modpack** is a performance-focused Minecraft 1.21.11 modpack built for the BigCraft server. It is optimized to improve rendering, exploration, and overall gameplay smoothness while keeping the core vanilla-style experience intact.

This pack is designed for players who want better performance, useful quality-of-life features, and improved world navigation without changing the game into a heavily modded experience. While it is specifically tuned for BigCraft, it can also be used on other vanilla-compatible 1.21.11 servers.

## Features
- **Performance optimization** for smoother gameplay
- **Enhanced rendering** with mods such as Iris and Voxy/VoxyServerSide
- **Improved chunk handling** through Concurrent Chunk Management Engine
- **Navigation tools** including Xaero’s Minimap and Xaero’s World Map
- **Extra utility** with Zoomify and Do a Barrel Roll
- **Designed for BigCraft** but usable on other compatible servers

## Current Version
At the moment, only the **HIGH** version is available. More versions are planned in the future, including configurations intended for lower-end computers.

# WARNING
BigCraft is not currently live, and under whitelist. This modpack is mainly intended for beta testers at this time.
